comment: Production 2026-11-10 11:00/12:00/13:00 ET: cio-capital-plan-record exited 0 with 23 decisions, all
already in the journal (written 0, pending 0), and an empty_reason of null. The dispatcher's output
verdict graded empty_reason_not_allowed -> RUN_FAILED and the breaker opened on a job that had done its
work. The producer now names `already_recorded` when the journal already holds every decision the plan
produced, and names nothing when decisions were pending but none was appended (that stays a failure).
Pins the producer's reason against the shipped contract's empty_allowed_reasons, so a reason the contract
does not list cannot be added silently. Hermetic: synthetic plan, journal and receipt writer, no DB.
